en.title: Ethereum Clients: What Comes Next?
en.summary: What comes after Glamsterdam for the software that runs Ethereum? At Ethereum Korea One: Genesis, client developers and a consensus researcher discuss ePBS, L1 scaling, ZK proving, and what Ethereum clients may look like in five to ten years.
speakers: Jun Song, Core Engineer, Offchain (Prysm)
Felix Lange, Geth Lead, Ethereum Foundation
Luca Zanolini, Researcher, Alumni of EF
Moderator: Youngseok Yang, CEO, Nodeinfra

ko.title: 플래시 보이스인가, 슈퍼 예측가인가? 예측 시장 사용자층 들여다보기
ko.summary: 예측 시장의 거래량을 실제로 움직이는 건 누구일까요? 뛰어난 예측가, 리테일, 아니면 봇일까요? Ethereum Korea One: Genesis에서 Pantera Capital의 Danning Sui가 Polymarket과 Kalshi 데이터를 파헤쳤습니다.
speakers: Danning Sui, Research Director, Pantera Capital

en.title: Flash Boys or Superforecasters? Prediction Market User Base
en.summary: Who is really driving prediction market volume: skilled forecasters, retail bettors, or bots? At Ethereum Korea One: Genesis, Pantera Capital's Danning Sui breaks down the data behind Polymarket and Kalshi.
speakers: Danning Sui, Research Director, Pantera Capital

ko.title: 재단 너머의 이더리움
ko.summary: 이더리움 재단이 몸집을 줄여가는 지금, 생태계의 성장은 누가 이어갈까요? Ethereum Korea One: Genesis에서 EthCC, Octant, ETHGlobal을 이끄는 사람들이 재단 바깥에서 이뤄지는 일들을 이야기했습니다.
speakers: Jerome de Tychey, Founder, EthCoordinate
Mashal Waqar, CMO, Octant
Kartik Talwar, Co-Founder, ETHGlobal
모더레이터: Jay Jang, Head of Business, Sunnyside Labs

en.title: Ethereum Beyond the Foundation
en.summary: As the Ethereum Foundation slims down, who keeps the ecosystem growing? At Ethereum Korea One: Genesis, the people behind EthCC, Octant, and ETHGlobal discuss the work happening beyond the Foundation.
speakers: Jerome de Tychey, Founder, EthCoordinate
Mashal Waqar, CMO, Octant
Kartik Talwar, Co-Founder, ETHGlobal
Moderator: Jay Jang, Head of Business, Sunnyside Labs

ko.title: 이더리움 발행량 전쟁
ko.summary: 이더리움은 보안을 위해 얼마를 지불해야 하고, 그 결정은 누가 내려야 할까요? Ethereum Korea One: Genesis에서 EIP-8363 공동 저자와 Lido의 스테이킹 총괄이 ETH 발행량의 미래를 두고 맞붙었습니다.
speakers: Jerome de Tychey, Founder, EthCoordinate
Isidoros Passadis, Chief of Staking, Lido
모더레이터: Hyung-Kyu Choi, Co-Founder, DSRV

en.title: Ethereum's Issuance Wars
en.summary: How much should Ethereum pay for its security, and who gets to decide? At Ethereum Korea One: Genesis, a co-author of EIP-8363 and Lido's Chief of Staking debate the future of ETH issuance.
speakers: Jerome de Tychey, Founder, EthCoordinate
Isidoros Passadis, Chief of Staking, Lido
Moderator: Hyung-Kyu Choi, Co-Founder, DSRV

ko.title: 계정 추상화의 미래
ko.summary: ERC-4337이 3년 넘게, EIP-7702가 1년 넘게 운영되고 있는데 왜 지금 다시 네이티브 계정 추상화일까요? Ethereum Korea One: Genesis에서 Geth 리드와 ZeroDev 테크 리드가 L1과 L2의 서로 다른 길을 비교했습니다.
speakers: Felix Lange, Geth Lead, Ethereum Foundation
Taek Lee, Tech Lead, ZeroDev
모더레이터: Seungmin Jeon, Core Engineer, Sunnyside Labs

en.title: Future of Account Abstraction
en.summary: With ERC-4337 live for over three years and EIP-7702 for over a year, why is native account abstraction back on the table? At Ethereum Korea One: Genesis, the Geth lead and ZeroDev's tech lead compare the L1 and L2 paths.
speakers: Felix Lange, Geth Lead, Ethereum Foundation
Taek Lee, Tech Lead, ZeroDev
Moderator: Seungmin Jeon, Core Engineer, Sunnyside Labs

ko.title: L2는 여전히 이더리움을 확장하고 있는가?
ko.summary: L1이 예상보다 빠르게 확장되고 있다면 L2는 무엇을 위해 존재할까요? Ethereum Korea One: Genesis에서 Offchain Labs, Optimism, StarkWare의 리더들이 L2가 여전히 이더리움을 확장하고 있는지 토론했습니다.
speakers: Ed Felten, Co-Founder & Chief Scientist, Offchain Labs
Chris Andreola, Senior Director, Commercial Strategy, Optimism
Ilia Volokh, Core Team Lead, StarkWare
모더레이터: Seungmin Jeon, Core Engineer, Sunnyside Labs

en.title: Are L2s Still Scaling Ethereum?
en.summary: If L1 is scaling faster than expected, what are L2s for? At Ethereum Korea One: Genesis, leaders from Offchain Labs, Optimism, and StarkWare debate whether L2s are still scaling Ethereum.
speakers: Ed Felten, Co-Founder & Chief Scientist, Offchain Labs
Chris Andreola, Senior Director, Commercial Strategy, Optimism
Ilia Volokh, Core Team Lead, StarkWare
Moderator: Seungmin Jeon, Core Engineer, Sunnyside Labs

ko.title: 온체인 에이전트: 자율 AI를 위한 경제 만들기
ko.summary: 사람들이 AI 에이전트에게 실제 돈을 맡기려면 무엇이 필요할까요? Ethereum Korea One: Genesis에서 Virtuals, Base, MetaMask가 자율 AI 에이전트를 위한 온체인 경제 만들기를 이야기했습니다.
speakers: Jansen Teng, Co-Founder, Virtuals
David Park, APAC Ecosystem Lead, Base
Francesco Andreoli, Director of DevRel, MetaMask
모더레이터: Junhyeok Yoo, Researcher, Four Pillars

en.title: Onchain Agents: Building an Economy for Autonomous AI
en.summary: What will it take for people to trust AI agents with real money? At Ethereum Korea One: Genesis, Virtuals, Base, and MetaMask discuss building an onchain economy for autonomous AI agents.
speakers: Jansen Teng, Co-Founder, Virtuals
David Park, APAC Ecosystem Lead, Base
Francesco Andreoli, Director of DevRel, MetaMask
Moderator: Junhyeok Yoo, Researcher, Four Pillars
